scope: Actual CEM planning on historical development inputs; no simulator actions, intervention refitting or new protected confirmation. Expansion requested after viewing the initial eight-case diagnostic
primary_population: The complete 56-case extension, n28/task; initial8 are not included in extension inferential tests. Pooled64 n32/task is descriptive and visibly identified as initial pilot plus extension
precision: Strict FP32, TF32 disabled; same original frozen fitted operators and task checkpoints
planner: Original pinned native CEM: 15 iterations,300 candidates,10 elites,6-step proposal[6,20], returned3-step prefix[3,20], same recorded candidate_seed per scenario/arm; original max-norm clipping and exact objective unchanged
native_comparator: Rerun native concurrently on the SAME physical GPU as the two edit arms for every extension context. Archived native traces remain provenance and a descriptive reproduction comparison, not the primary comparator. All arms have exact traced/untraced selected-plan and private-RNG parity
initial_identity: Exact initial300 candidate-action bytes across native/learned/random, same context and seed. Compute actual initial elite overlap; do not require10/10 as a success gate
later_identity: Proposal populations evolve independently; later candidate indices are not paired actions. Compare proposal distributions and returned action coordinates, not later elite-ID overlap
primary_metrics: learned-minus-random returned-prefix RMS distance from concurrent native
learned-minus-random mean proposal-mean RMS divergence from native over all15iterations
learned-minus-random mean proposal differential-entropy change from native over all15iterations
additional_metrics: Absolute learned/native and random/native prefix RMS/L2; every iteration's proposal-mean/std RMS and preclip Gaussian differential entropy, margins, initial elite overlap, score changes. Prefix is60coordinates; proposals120. First candidate-array divergence iteration can be recorded descriptively, never used to select cases
entropy: Native diagonal-Gaussian differential entropy before clipping and mean insertion, in unchanged model action coordinates; not physical uncertainty or action quality
resampling_unit: Context within task, n28 extension; pair all arms and iterations using identical context bootstrap weights. Candidates/iterations/action coordinates are not independent samples
primary_intervals: Paired-context percentile intervals with Bonferroni family6 (two tasks times three primary metrics), quantiles0.05/12 and1-0.05/12. Report marginal95 intervals alongside; no claim of a population benefit from an unsigned perturbation metric
display: Large per-task curves of mean proposal RMS with +/-1 scenario standard error, plus individual endpoint distributions; clearly label SE and not confidence intervals. All56 extension outcomes shown; initial8 can be separate faint reference. No clipping long tails or selecting favorable iterations
power: n28/task extension and n32/task descriptive pool improve precision over n4 but do not guarantee power or significance; with comparable variance mean SE scales as1/sqrt(n). No outcome-based sample-size expansion beyond this fixed registry
qualification: Pinned vendor/input/checkpoint/fit/source/protocol hashes, assignedGPU UUID, unchanged weights and globalRNG, exact traced/untraced plan/privateRNG parity and actual30callbacks per search. Native, learned,random all use same receivingruntime. Preserve technical failures; no efficacy-based exclusions or parity relaxation
runtime: Tag first newcase for engineering/timing only; continue all56 once qualified. Existing C pilot continues independently. At most two additional qualified low-cost US singleGPU workers; no large training parallelism or collective communication
budget: Existing campaign65USD total and14USD/hour aggregate; this extension incremental ceiling15USD inclusive setup/network/compute, reserve5USDcloud remains. Prefer total4GPU around2USD/hour; measure price/runtime before rental
deadline: New-host setup bound25min perhost. Scientific deadline2026-09-13T22:00Z or budgetguard, then archive and release. No unbounded idle hosts or automatic resampling
preservation: Per-case full native/learned/random candidate actions and traces, compact iteration summaries/costs/elites, all source/identity/parity metadata, report/DONE and clouddownloadSHA receipt; cloudfirst with no bulk tensor downloads to laptop. Archived original8 and new56 remain separately source-bound
